planner_output.refinement_instructions: Build the first trace from scratch. First, use the OCR result to cite the exact given text/number from the diagram; preserve the measurement only if it is directly visible in OCR. Next, use the frame-level chart_analyzer output on the same retrieved frames to identify the correct static question frame and to describe the circle arrangement and which parts are shaded. Do not infer the geometry from the video summary alone. The rewritten trace should explicitly ground: (1) the large circle's given size, (2) the presence of four equal inner circles, and (3) whether the shaded region is the union of the four small circles or the remaining parts of the large circle outside them. Then compute the needed radii and areas from that grounded structure, showing the formula clearly. If multiple retrieved frames differ, use the frame whose OCR and diagram interpretation most completely match the static problem statement. Update the final answer to the option matching the computed value; if the computed value is approximate, explain the closest-option mapping.
